experiment: Multi-VAE retraining on the official Yelp2018 LightGCN split
limitations: The paper-reference values are contextual and are not a fresh LightGCN baseline.
The internal validation fold is a deterministic 10% carve-out from official train.
Runtime and device measurements are specific to this host.

paper_reference.note: Published Table 4 values are contextual references only; no LightGCN baseline was retrained in this workflow.

source.title: LightGCN: Simplifying and Powering Graph Convolution Network for Recommendation

scope_note: Official LightGCN-PyTorch train/test files are used. Validation is derived only from official train; the official test fold is accessed once after selection.
